priority_definitions.P1: Material correctness, scientific credibility, major product friction or important contract/integration defect.
priority_definitions.P2: Meaningful usability/workflow clarity, contributor experience or bounded technical debt.
priority_definitions.P3: Polish, convenience, low-severity documentation or optional quality improvement.

effort_definitions.XS: Less than half a day; tightly bounded.
effort_definitions.RESEARCH: Implementation unknown until evidence resolves; not a delivery promise.

contributor_suitability_rules.beginner-safe: Clear files/surface, low scientific risk, deterministic validation, no architectural prerequisite, bounded output; eligible for good first issue.
contributor_suitability_rules.contributor-friendly: Bounded and documented, but needs workflow/tooling familiarity or maintainer interpretation review; help wanted without beginner promise.
contributor_suitability_rules.maintainer-owned: Cross-prerequisite scientific decisions and final promotion gates; no beginner/help-wanted label.
contributor_suitability_rules.research-heavy: External evidence or domain judgment determines whether implementation is warranted; no beginner/help-wanted label.

contribution_readiness.rubric: Ten ordinal dimensions, 0 absent/unsafe, 1 partial/conflicting, 2 clear/evidenced; heuristic, not a user study.

product_debt_review.finding: Results shows /100; objective help exists in Goals. Explain preference-weighted utility at Results and distinguish it from coverage or accuracy.
Roles and trade-off tables already exist; add a plain-language example and distinguish inspect/rerank/apply/rerun rather than rebuilding the explorer.
Configuration changes already expose per-Cell azimuth deltas. Network optimization varies azimuth; add a concise fixed-input boundary with score help.
Observed both committed assets: light is older single-Cell Setup; dark is the later eight-Cell workspace. Capture matching actual app state.
Existing notes explain retained evidence. Known guard errors display only error.message and omit a safe next step; limits themselves are intentional.
Draft/Version/Run/report exclusions are already stated. A remaining early Getting Started full-project sentence is overbroad; align it within the bounded export recovery/help task.
Visible run action, planning-estimate notice, settings-only sample and first decision text already exist. No new wizard or generic onboarding ticket.
Current guide describes the loop; sample has empty selection and no dataset binding/results. Add explicit reproducible inputs, a comparison and evidence delivery.
Executive summary, baseline, alternatives, lineage, unavailable states, offline artifact downloads and map-sampling disclosure exist. Add a reader guide, not another renderer or summary.
Cell/tower/site/sector aliases can confuse planning records with physical infrastructure. API and candidate limits are already scoped; add one compact linked glossary.
Retry-After guidance and independent Measurement6 scope guard exist with regressions. Do not repeat those issues; remaining project export guard recovery is separate.

scientific_roadmap.evidence_gap_or_state: Tooling, CSV diagnostics and synthetic fixtures exist; latest readiness has 0 canonical field observations and no defensible canonical MAE/RMSE.
83 registered candidates conflict with NONE; matching transitions do not settle source authority. Version-specific collector/device evidence is missing; external evidence blocks the issue.
Exact mapping is 0; public planning records are not measured sites or power/antenna/height truth. Require exact identity and field-level provenance; external source access blocks the issue.
Receiver AGL is user-estimated and device response uncalibrated; field tracker owns receiver/endpoint evidence, resource issue owns quantity/reference-plane evidence.
CellInfo bandwidth unavailable; ServiceState vectors lack exact identity association. Do not substitute configured bandwidth or relabel RSRP as carrier power.
Independent endpoint/outdoor/LOS annotations are missing; model-predicted LOS cannot serve as validation truth. Track within the final reference-set gate.
Ordinary CSV holdout-checked global dB correction is implemented. Canonical calibration requires trustworthy compatible data and independent holdouts; no calibration implementation ticket yet.

Optional profile diagnostics and corrected clearance primitive exist. Canonical network terrain remains unavailable; source semantics, local control, uncertainty and diffraction qualification still block promotion. Do not reopen the corrected sign bug.
Pack metadata/manual path-profile and isolated P.1411 morphology inputs exist; no authoritative canonical spatially joined clutter evidence or validated effect justifies adding losses.

Analytic and single-element reference cuts exist; measured vendor pattern import/validation is absent. TX evidence issue can establish what evidence exists before any model/import feature is admitted.
Readiness/process JSON bodies exist without OpenAPI body schemas. This is a software contract gap, not new physical validation.

rf_planner_gap_matrix.decision: Point-to-point terrain is partial supporting capability; canonical network path does not consume it. Defer promotion until source/control/uncertainty gates pass.
Pack sidecars and explicit reference/diagnostic inputs exist; no automatic canonical clutter join. No backlog feature without authoritative data and a decision need.
Bounded CSV/GeoJSON planning inventory already works. Operator verification/mapping does not; research truth issue covers evidence, not a broad enterprise importer.
PCI is validated metadata; Core Lab neighbor edges are simulated coordination, not RF PCI conflict or neighbor-list planning. No demonstrated product prerequisite.
No UE mobility/handover simulator. Collector identity transitions and Core Lab paths do not establish handover behavior.
Scalar Cell load and demand weights exist; no traffic/scheduler/throughput/capacity model. No new system without user/evidence basis.
Per-Cell frequency/band/channel/bandwidth and co-channel grouping exist. No per-Cell carrier aggregation or multi-carrier scheduler; extension not currently justified.
Analytic presets and 3GPP single-element cuts already exist; no measured/vendor tabular import. Evidence and interpolation/validation requirements must precede such a feature.
User RSRP residuals and isolated evidence tooling work; credible canonical field results remain blocked. SINR/RSRQ/RSSI require independent resource context.
Known-record recommendations, bounded area/candidate search, apply-as-scenario and re-evaluation exist; ownership, permitting, cost and backhaul excluded.
Modeled finite-horizon co-channel RSRP/SINR/RSRQ/RSSI, load/reuse/resources exist. Adjacent-channel, uplink and dynamic scheduling are absent and not currently justified extensions.
